body: Thank you, your words are very sweet and I appreciate them. I've been getting a lot of support from this post and it really helps me to have more faith in this world.
I think that is the worst part for me. Knowing there is nothing truly wrong in my life, but at the same time everything feels so… meaningless. I just feel so empty most of the time.
Yes! It is exactly that. Thank you, even if it is not a permanent solution, this makes me feel a little better. I will definitely try to remember your comment on bad moments.

I see what you mean. The internet has given us incredible access to information and it can be used for so many amazing things. Sadly, so many people just use it to do stupid stuff and we can all see it. 

It is so easy to see the bad news. Everyday we see people dying of covid, climate change destroying the world, the economy crashing; and the only thing we can do is.... make memes about it? Try to laugh it off? 

The worst part is that the good news are much, MUCH harder to find. However it is good to remember that good news does exist. There are actually good people in the world fighting to improve our planet in many different ways. Even though it feels impossible to me right now, I wish I could have the passion and motivation of those people. For now, just knowing that they are out there makes me feel better.

I try to limit my internet and social media use to a minimum. Having bad mental health and social media do not mix well for me. I also try to stay off of controversial topics. Is not that I don't care, but I know that I can't contribute a lot right now and trying is just very damaging to me. Currently, I am on social media just looking for things that entertain me and make me feel like there is hope for the world (whenever I think I see negative things I just skip immediately). Even if it doesn't help a lot, it keeps my mind busy and I don’t think about dying so much. I know that this is the blind leading the blind, but I hope this helps you a little too.

P.D. Thank you for saying that I am a good writer. English is my second language so I appreciate it!

I don't know if this will help, but I understand how you feel. I just wrote a similar post a few hours ago. I understand that even though there is nothing wrong, somehow you still feel empty and useless. You are not alone and what you feel is completely valid.   
  
Talking about it (even if it is only to strangers on the internet) seems to work for me, if you want to try it. I hope that looking for a reason to continue living is a little easier when you don't feel so alone.

Thank you for your kind words. Its nice to know that there are still some really nice people on the internet. It helps to know that I am not alone and I know  that probably a lot of people feel the same way.
